tasks.subject: Task 1: OS exit-request flag
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a thread-safe one-way exit-request signal to OS, independent of scene/.

**Files:**
- Modify: core/os/os.h
- Modify: core/os/os.cpp
- Test: tests/core/os/test_os.h

```json:metadata
{"files": ["core/os/os.h", "core/os/os.cpp", "tests/core/os/test_os.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.* --headless --test --test-case=\"[OS] Exit request flag\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["request_exit stores code and sets flag", "is_exit_requested returns flag", "uses SafeFlag", "doctest passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Honor exit request in Main::iteration()
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Main loop ends gracefully when OS::is_exit_requested() is true.

**Files:**
- Modify: main/main.cpp (Main::iteration(), after process() block, before fixed_fps early return)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["main/main.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "scons platform=macos target=editor dev_build=yes tests=yes -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)", "acceptanceCriteria": ["OR is_exit_requested into exit after process()", "before fixed_fps early return", "builds cleanly"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: push_fatal utility function + project setting
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add push_fatal vararg utility (log + conditional graceful quit), register it, define project setting, unit-test decision logic.

**Files:**
- Modify: core/variant/variant_utility.h
- Modify: core/variant/variant_utility.cpp
- Modify: main/main.cpp
- Test: tests/core/variant/test_variant_utility.h

```json:metadata
{"files": ["core/variant/variant_utility.h", "core/variant/variant_utility.cpp", "main/main.cpp", "tests/core/variant/test_variant_utility.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.* --headless --test --test-case=\"[VariantUtility] push_fatal decision logic\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["logs via ERR_PRINT", "0 args too-few error no exit", "editor hint log only", "setting false log only", "else request_exit EXIT_FAILURE", "setting default true", "doctest passes"]}
```
